channel.title: Brali Updates
channel.description: Verified weekly and monthly changes to Brali knowledge, research, data, discovery, and agent-facing surfaces.

item.title: Brali this week: discoverability, evidence boundaries, and a subscribe path
item.description: Brali opened stronger AI and search discovery surfaces, added a monthly research audit, tightened evidence boundaries, and made public project updates subscribable without requiring an account.

item.title: Brali this week: knowledge quality, query access, and agent adoption
item.description: Brali moved beyond a large hack archive toward a smaller trusted core, problem-first topic entry points, reproducible agent evaluation, and easier zero-install access.

item.title: August 2026: from hack collection to evidence-aware knowledge platform
item.description: The August direction was consolidation: stronger quality boundaries, canonical Topics and Protocols, research decisions, machine-readable APIs, and practical ways for people and agents to retrieve the same knowledge.
